LanguageData.Gun_MN91-30_RWP.label: Mosin Nagant 91/30
LanguageData.Gun_MN91-30_RWP.description: A bolt-action rifle of Russian origin, the Mosin Nagant 91/30 is renowned for its accuracy and durability. With a slow firing rate, it excels at long-range engagements, providing a powerful shot that can pierce through armor. Its historical significance and rugged design make it a favorite among survivalists and collectors alike.
